name: binance.deposit
description: Deposit native ETH or an exact ERC20 token from a protected EVM wallet into a Binance main account or subaccount using its own credentials. Live Binance metadata selects the asset/network route; completion requires canonical chain evidence and matching usable Binance credit.
coverage: Synthetic broker-composite transport and canonical fake-EVM proof; live funding capabilities and acceptance remain separately reported.
completion: Original transaction identity is canonical and finalized, and exactly one usable matching Binance credit plus the corresponding free-balance increase is observed.

semantics.accounts: Main or subaccount using its own credential; no master required. Parent-authorized hierarchy reads remain optional.
semantics.amount: exact finite amount; amount=all is unsupported
semantics.approval: Fresh Touch ID binds source wallet, destination account, chain, asset, deposit address, amount, gas envelope and displayed USD ceilings. Fresh quote evidence may vary within those ceilings.
semantics.coin: Binance asset identity; never resolved from an EVM ticker
semantics.completion: chain submission alone is insufficient; matching usable deposit history and balance delta are required
semantics.legacyDefaults: Omitted coin/network select ETH on Ethereum mainnet; omitted chainId resolves the reviewed Binance network mapping. ERC20 token contract must be explicit.
semantics.maxFeeEth: Maximum total chain-native fee in ETH. The wallet transfer reserves 20% gas-unit and up to 50% fee-quote headroom, including priority fees, within this cap before approval; routine gas changes within the frozen envelope are accepted.
semantics.network: explicit Binance network code matched to current metadata and a configured Fin EVM chain
semantics.recipient: fixed from the authenticated account's current Binance deposit-address endpoint
semantics.recovery: Reconcile the original operation after response loss, delayed credit or restart; do not resend under a new request ID.
semantics.sourceCoverage: Configured Fin EVM chains with an explicit reviewed Binance network mapping; other source chains, memo/tag routes and non-unit denominations are unavailable.
semantics.token: native or exact ERC20 contract; contract and decimals are checked against both Binance and chain metadata

name: binance.transfer
description: SPOT transfer between a configured main account and one configured subaccount. Main authority uses universalTransfer with clientTranId; a source-child authority can return SPOT to its configured parent through subToMaster, whose receipt is persisted by Fin.

authority.description:
Use a configured main connection for existing universal transfers; for
child-to-parent, select the source child to sign Binance subToMaster.

coverage: Endpoint fixtures and synthetic transport; production account permissions and live financial acceptance remain unverified.
completion: One matching successful history row plus observed source debit and destination credit.

semantics.amount: exact decimal string
semantics.authority: For main→child or legacy main-authorized child→main, select the main account. For source-child→parent only, select the child as authority; Fin uses subToMaster and sends no clientTranId or recipient parameter.
semantics.subToMasterReceipt: Fin persists Binance txnId against the immutable local submission before returning. If the response is lost before the receipt is persisted, the result remains unknown and history is not inferred from amount or time.

name: binance.whitelist
description: Inspect withdrawal-address whitelist flags, optionally checking an exact coin/network/address/memo. Editing requires Binance's website/app.
coverage: Binance own-account GET routes use the selected connection's credential; no parent/master lookup is used. If Binance denies a specific route, its response is reported for that capability only. Synthetic tests; authenticated live observations pending.
completion: Bounded address-book observation only; no address creation, whitelist modification, account-wide enforcement or withdrawal eligibility proof.

semantics.human_action: Use Binance withdrawal Address Management to edit entries and complete its security checks, then repeat this read.
semantics.limits: Per-entry whitelist flags do not prove account-wide enforcement or that a security cooldown has elapsed.

name: binance.withdraw
description: Binance SPOT withdrawal on any advertised coin/network to a named wallet or explicit public address, with exact memo/tag, limits and fees.
coverage: Endpoint fixtures and synthetic transport; production account permissions and live financial acceptance remain unverified.
completion: Matching venue withdrawal plus bounded source debit/fee and independently verified destination receipt. Unobserved routes remain pending after venue completion.

semantics.amount: exact decimal string
semantics.coinNetworkSelection: live Binance metadata; no coin/network allowlist
semantics.destinationReceipt: independent observer required for terminal financial settlement; otherwise explicitly pending. The configured Arbitrum One and Robinhood Chain observers accept successful canonical sequencer inclusion with exact recipient and amount proof, without waiting for parent-chain finality. Venue route availability remains separate.
semantics.ordinaryExecution: no run or restoration plan required; exact bounds, fresh approval, reservations and independent receipt checks remain enforced

name: binance.withdrawal-history
description: Paginated Binance withdrawal history; venue completion and destination chain receipt are separate.
coverage: Endpoint fixtures and synthetic transport; production account permissions and live financial acceptance remain unverified.
completion: Venue withdrawal history observed.

semantics.amount: exact decimal string

name: exchange.markets
description: Read public market metadata (venue snapshot/page).
coverage: Public market/ticker reads through official CCXT Rust. No account enrollment or writes. Coinbase market discovery returns at most 1000 spot products; venue pagination metadata is retained, completeness is not asserted.
completion: Returns venue public data; does not imply any financial settlement.

semantics.exactness: Venue decimal strings and envelopes preserved; Hyperliquid ticker selects its matching market/context. Market observations are not authoritative accounting.
semantics.verification: offline_synthetic; see verification report for public network checks

name: exchange.order-book
description: Read exact public bid and ask levels for one verified exchange market.

depth.description: Maximum number of levels per side.

market_type.description: Must match the venue's supported market scope.

pair.description: Exact native market identifier from exchange.markets, binance.spot.markets, or binance.futures.markets as applicable.

coverage: Fixture-tested public order books: Binance spot and USDⓈ-M perpetual, Kraken spot, Hyperliquid primary perpetual, OKX spot, Coinbase Advanced spot, and Bybit spot. Each request first verifies the exact native identifier and market scope against venue metadata. No credentials or writes.
completion: Returns a timestamped public depth snapshot; it is not an execution guarantee or authoritative financial accounting.

semantics.exactness: Raw response decimals are emitted as strings. Observed time is request start. Venue timestamp is null unless the venue supplied a valid timestamp.

description: Capture a broker-combined financial snapshot for every configured resource and unresolved journal identity.
coverage: Combined snapshots from all configured reviewed adapters and nonterminal durable operations.
completion: complete is true only when all observers completed and the operation journal has no unresolved records.

name: uniswap.quote
description: Quote supported Uniswap v3 single-pool fee tiers using QuoterV2.
coverage: Rust implementation; synthetic and fixed-fork evidence recorded separately. Human/mainnet acceptance remains pending.
completion: Writes require canonical original transaction proof, confirmations, bounded actual gas, application-specific events and inclusion-block post-state.

semantics.amount: Exact decimal asset quantity; no floating-point conversion or rounding.
semantics.bounded_all: Supported full-balance operations require finite max_amount. Cash sweeps freeze observed units; full Aave repayment/withdrawal proves zero remaining scaled debt/claim. Every actual write receives a fresh preview and authorization.
semantics.deadline_example: Fixed schema illustration; replace with the current Unix timestamp plus 120 seconds before preview.
semantics.retry: Reconcile the original persisted hash, never blind replay.
